problem: The existing Smoke bridge produced a fade-like result even with a midpoint image. Execution success did not establish the requested volumetric effect.

verified_upstream_contract.purpose: Generate art-directed fluid footage from flat painted keyframes, either as an element on black or an entire scene.
verified_upstream_contract.guide: Control video with the same dimensions and length as output; first and last painted frames, black intermediate frames, optional painted keys at 8k+1 indices.
verified_upstream_contract.guide_downscale: Read factor 2 from adapter metadata via LTXICLoRALoaderModelOnly.
verified_upstream_contract.i2v: Disabled in the shipped plume example.

decision.status: Research candidate; not integrated or quality-validated.
decision.reason: This is a released fluid-specific model and native Comfy workflow, but its painted-volume contract is not a ready-made two-scene transition. Do not silently substitute it for the existing endpoint-conditioned graph or claim its sample is our result.
decision.next_requirement: Resolve the conditioning and compositing contract for clear source and destination scenes before implementing the Smoke transition adaptation.
decision.downloads: Only public text and graph metadata read in memory; no weights downloaded.
decision.version_note: The author withdrew version 1. The pinned version 2 card describes synthetic training clips with a published provenance manifest. Do not use the older revision surfaced in search results.
